newsitem.title: JAPAN: DOLLAR SEEN RANGE-BOUND IN ASIA, EYES TRADE DATA.
newsitem.headline: DOLLAR SEEN RANGE-BOUND IN ASIA, EYES TRADE DATA.

text.p: The dollar is expected to move in a narrow range against the yen during Asian trading time on Friday, with the market likely to shrug off wild movements overnight in European currencies such as sterling, which tumbled against the mark and the dollar, dealers said.

The market awaits the release of Japan's June current account surplus data at 8.50 a.m. (2350 GMT Thursday) since fears of renewed U.S.-Japan trade friction have recently limited the dollar's rise. Dealers said stronger-than-expected figures could push the dollar down, but the downside will be well-supported below 118 yen on bids from Japanese investors.
